change: The label-free check of the slot draw was a text search over fork's source that rejected the word 'phase' (present in its docstring). Replaced by a structural check (the draw is slot_index(g, n), whose only inputs are the fixed-seed generator and the history length) in C0, and a functional check in C1 (fork's drawn indices equal the content-free sequence slot_index(rng(world,'slot'), n) over the history lengths). The draw itself, the arms, rules, worlds and doses are unchanged.

C1 check 2 assumed a write-inhibited record leaves the native fast/slow stores unchanged; the native fly decays both stores in every event (model_evo.event: exp(-dt/fast_tau), exp(-dt/slow_tau)). The check now compares the write-inhibited record with the same record run as ordinary non-teaching events on an identical clone (must be equal), requires the written record to differ, and requires equal clock and warmup counter. The learner, arms, rules, worlds and doses are unchanged.
